source_discrepancies.resolution: Retain the existing manual-qualified IR/PAC access and the current checker's exact 23 selected DMA CSR views; this SPI extension does not alter register schema.
All five paired examples omit R in step 28; their own DMA CSR field tables and own SVD identify DSTINC in CSR. The quoted typo is recorded, not silently corrected.

limits.request_gates: CR1 DMARX16 and DMATX17. RXNE nonempty requests read DR; TXE empty requests write DR. DR offset0x18; CPU MMIO remains typed 32-bit.
limits.rxne_clear: Each own ISR and interrupt table explicitly says read DR or write0 ICR.RXNE clears RXNE; no UART RC analogy used.
limits.error: MODF forces EN0; OV overwrites unread data. UD/SSERR described for slave mode; unexpected observed errors remain failures. SPI error IRQ required because peripheral failure may prevent one DMA terminal.
limits.icr: R1W0 at0x14, reset/noop0xff, flags7:1, destructive FLUSH0; use typed no-op selected clear. Whole-zero example initialization is not an operational error recovery/drain proof.
limits.dma_completion: Own TC means all data correctly transferred; STATUS5 complete; STATUS1 address range,2 stop request,3 source,4 destination errors. Require recorded own TC/noTE/STATUS5 on each owned channel; TE wins. The paired example then closes both gates and waits BUSY0 before releasing SSI.
limits.error_drain_limit: No own source establishes memory quiescence from EN0, gate closure, reset, clock-off, count0, timeout or BUSY0 following DMA error/ambiguous cancellation. Preserve quarantine of channels, staging, endpoint, pins/config and clocks.
limits.irq_wait_limit: Own IER exposes ready/edge/error IRQs but no BUSY-clear IRQ. Final wire wait remains cooperative and not time-bounded.
limits.f020_topology: Only CH1/CH2, so paired SPI DMA consumes both. SPI1 and SPI2 example deployments must be separate when ownership is permanent.
limits.four_channel_topology: CH1 IRQ9, CH2/CH3 shared IRQ10, CH4 IRQ11. Pair completion/error handling must preserve sibling channel events.
limits.w031: External SPI unavailable while RF in use; keep existing RF exclusion and whole-GPIOB handover constraints. No internal RF DMA qualification.
